title: 是否考虑对Skill结构模式优化
author: iampilot
body_preview: 当前，Agent skill已成为Agent的基本单元之一。但当前的SKILL.md中name、description及详细技能的结构模式导致Agent在加载时必须读取完整的SKILL.md文件内容（langchain及agentscope相关源码均有体现），然后提取name、description。  在Agent自主配置场景中，存在Agent注册了某个Skill但实际并未使用该能力的情况，且当单个Agent集成的Skill较多的情况下，作为基本单元的Skill每次注册均需读取完整的内容并赋值给对象，以此避免后续若使用该skill需重复读取的性能缺陷，但实际并未使用的Skill也占用着内存空间。  因此，是否有更新skill结构模式来减少对应的性能损耗的想法，例如：头部描述信息与详细内容完全分离，注册时仅需读取头部描述信息相关内容即可，待Agent实际选用该Skill时在进行详细内容的读...

title: [PROPOSAL] Cookbook: Giving an agent a grounded view of its own behavior over time
author: WGlynn
body_preview: An agent usually has no view of its own behavior over time. Each turn starts fresh, so a slow drift (more retries, more tool errors, longer paths to the same result) is invisible to it even though the signal is sitting in its own logs. A small self-observation step closes that gap: the agent periodically reads its own recent activity and produces a short report on how it is doing, including flags...
